svg.text: Acyclic Lock-Ordering & Partitioned Concurrency Invariant (packages/host/src/keyed-queue.ts · ADR-0009, ADR-0016)

text.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Halt order: Routine -> Goal -> Mission -> Team | Queue order: Routine(id -> project -> goal) -> Goal(goalId -> teamId) -> Team(runId -> project) -> Session(id -> provider:nativeId -> admission)

text.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No upward queue acquisition (Team reads Goals via sync port). Heavy work (prepare, checks, git publish, permission AI) runs outside runId queues; mapConcurrent bounds fan-out (8 goals/missions/routines, 16 teams).

text.font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', ui-monospace, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
